description: A behaviorally anchored competency evaluation matrix developed by Li Feiyan et al.
title: OBE-based 72-item competency evaluation matrix for clinical medical trainees in the AI era

description: A structured performance-assessment tool used by trained assessors to evaluate neurosurgery residents' operative nuances and skill in aneurysm-clipping simulation.
title: Objective Structured Assessment of Aneurysm Clipping Skills (OSAACS) tool

description: OSATS and GOALS are validated global rating-scale assessments used by surgical educators and researchers to evaluate operative technical performance, including laparoscopic skills.
title: Objective Structured Assessment of Technical Skill (OSATS) and Global Operative Assessment of Laparoscopic Skills (GOALS)

description: The OSAUS scale is a structured performance-assessment instrument for evaluating ultrasound skills, developed for use in medical education and clinical competency assessment.
title: Objective Structured Assessment of Ultrasound Skills (OSAUS) scale

description: A five-point, three-domain observational scoring scale developed from Chinese standardized resident-assessment criteria to evaluate suturing quality, technique, and completion time from blinded video ratings by surgical experts.
title: Objective three-domain scoring scale for cosmetic suturing skills with blinded three-rater video assessment

description: A 78-item multiple-choice mathematics achievement test developed by a large urban school district and administered at the end of the school year.
title: Objectives by Strand test

description: A paper-based, researcher-designed working-memory capacity assessment for preschool children that uses missing-letter word reconstruction and ordered recall tasks.
title: Objects-span tri-tasks test

description: OPTEL is an observation protocol developed with the Region 15 Comprehensive Center for the California Department of Education to support standardized evaluation of English learners' English proficiency during academic learning and reclassification decisions.
title: Observation Protocol for Teachers of English Learners (OPTEL)

description: A 12-item observation-based rating instrument developed by Iversen Else Dalsgaard et al.
title: Observation Scheme-12 (OS-12)

description: A 25-item CPR simulation observation checklist developed by Ammar et al.
title: Observer tool (OT)

description: OUCAT is a 123-item validated instrument for assessing PGY-2 and PGY-3 residents’ competency in routine mid-trimester fetal ultrasound scanning.
title: Obstetric Ultrasound Competency Assessment Tool (OUCAT)
